Mamata Banerjee to Address Martyrs' Day Rally Amid Delimitation Controversy

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee is set to address a Martyrs' Day rally, where she may highlight the 'stolen mandate' issue related to delimitation. The rally comes amid controversy over the delimitation of parliamentary constituencies in West Bengal. The government has called for an all-party meet on the issue, while critics argue that it is an attempt to suppress opposition voices.
